mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals economic weakness that triggers a flight to quality in equities, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 1-year windows is < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60d returns in > 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is < 0.01 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve's likely response of maintaining high interest rates suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY, or the Rank IC over 1-year windows is < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1200.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening in the residential sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over 1-year windows is < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in unemployment indicates a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as corporate earnings face dual pressures.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 60d returns in > 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is < 0.01 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 1-year windows is < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days as investors anticipate reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over 1-year windows is < 0.02.
